name: Custom Score
summary: Combines selected algorithms into one encrypted score. Reputo adjusts each result to the same range and applies the weights you choose.
description:
### What it does
Combines the results of one or more algorithms into one encrypted score.

### How it works
- Each selected algorithm runs separately. You can add each algorithm only once.
- A user receives a final score only when every selected algorithm has a result for them. A score of `0` still counts as a result.
- Before combining the results, Reputo changes each algorithm's score range to 0–100. It uses the lowest and highest scores in the snapshot. If those scores are equal, every adjusted score for that algorithm is `0`.
- A weight above `0` controls how much each algorithm affects the final score.
- Reputo calculates a weighted average while the scores remain encrypted. It then sends the final encrypted score to DeepID.

### Data used
The results from the selected algorithms.

### Results
- Each selected algorithm keeps its original decentralized identifier (DID) type and result files.
- The details JSON file contains the settings, score ranges, and run status. It does not contain readable user scores or encrypted values.

inputs.label: Algorithms
inputs.description: Choose the algorithms to combine. Add each one only once, then set a weight above `0`. A higher weight gives an algorithm more effect on the final score.

outputs.label: Custom score details (JSON)
outputs.description: Settings, score ranges, and run status. This file does not contain readable user scores or encrypted values. Each algorithm's result files remain separate.
